title: Supported product-open tensor restriction and counit comparison
statement: For a finite commutative ring A, arbitrary maps a:Xbar to B, b:Zbar to B, opens j:X to Xbar and k:Z to Zbar, M in D(X_proet,A) and N in D(Z_proet,A), use the maps of [def-pur-product-open-tensor-projection-data]. Then w=(chi tensor identity) followed by e; the source m tensor P_tJ of w is isomorphic to u_!D; and restrictW inverse followed by P_u(w) is the open unit at D. No proper projection or compactification exchange map occurs in this statement.

source.place: Symmetry paragraph, proper reduction; explicit proof Steps 1--5 of lem-pur-product-open-tensor-projection.

proof.text: Apply open tensor normalization to j_q and i. The open unit at N identifies P_iP_tJ with P_vN; the two tensor maps and the open compositor identify the source with u_!D. Restriction of the composite is precisely the tensor-pullback and open-unit comparison restrictW, followed by the unit at D. Restriction of chi is beta inverse by the adjunction triangle; further restriction uses beta unit normalization. The normalized two-stage comparison e therefore gives the same restriction as w. Both source and target lie in the fully faithful image of u_!, so the two maps agree. This never inverts chi.

mathlib_searches.query: The tensor of an open adjunction counit with an object extended by zero is an isomorphism and restricts to the identity.
mathlib_searches.results: Adjunction.counitAsIsoOfIso and isIso_counit_of_iso (Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monad.Adjunction) concern an equivalence, not tensor-supported objects. Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId concerns ordinary scheme modules. None states the finite pro-etale derived comparisons.

mathlib_searches.query: Open tensor product comparison on two product open immersions agrees with tensoring the open counit and restricts to the open unit.
mathlib_searches.results: Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp and restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app concern ordinary scheme module restriction. Scheme.Pullback.tensorCongr_SpecTensorTo concerns affine scheme products, not derived open extension. No matching map identity.

lean.statement: theorem productOpenSupportNormalization (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {Xb Zb B X Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : Xb ⟶ B) (b : Zb ⟶ B) (j : X ⟶ Xb) (k : Z ⟶ Zb) [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsOpenImmersion k] (M : FiniteD A X) (N : FiniteD A Z) : w A a b j k M N = tensorMap A (product a b) (chi A a b j k M) (𝟙 ((pull A (second a b)).obj (J A k N))) ≫ e A a b j k M N ∧ Nonempty (tensor A (product a b) (m A a b j k M) ((pull A (second a b)).obj (J A k N)) ≅ (finiteShriek A (productOpen a b j k)).obj (D A a b j k M N)) ∧ (restrictW A a b j k M N).inv ≫ (pull A (productOpen a b j k)).map (w A a b j k M N) = (openUnit A (productOpen a b j k) (D A a b j k M N)).hom
